title: Many Faces
description: Save custom name + skin "personas" and switch between them instantly. Built for roleplay and ReplayMod recordings in singleplayer.
body:
# Many Faces

Become anyone. **Many Faces** lets you save a roster of **personas**, each one a
custom **username**, **skin**, and **body model**, and switch between them
instantly in-game. Built for roleplay, machinima, and **ReplayMod** recordings.

## Features
- **Save unlimited personas**: a username + a custom skin PNG + Classic/Slim model.
- **Switch in one click**: open the menu, click a persona, you're them.
- **ReplayMod-ready**: your persona name is baked into the recording, and the
  right skin is matched back on playback, so each recorded character looks correct.
- **Dead-simple skins**: pick any `.png` with the native file picker. No uploads,
  no Mojang account swapping.
- **Real name change in singleplayer**: your persona name shows in chat and the
  tab list, not just floating above your head.
- Open with `/persona` or the **K** key (rebindable).

## How to use
1. Press **K** (or run `/persona`).
2. Click **Add Persona**, enter a name, choose a skin PNG, pick Classic or Slim.
3. Click a persona to become it. Hit **Reset to real name** to go back.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API**
- Java 21
- **Client-side only.** Install on your own client; nothing to put on a server.

## Good to know
- The name change uses your **singleplayer** world's integrated server. This is a
  singleplayer / recording tool. It does not change how you appear to other
  players on a multiplayer server.
- Custom skins are rendered **on your own client**. Other players won't see them;
  in ReplayMod playback they're matched by the recorded name.

Personas are stored in `config/persona_mod/` so they persist across worlds.
